description: Land Aquisition - Girakaduwa, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a public notice under Section 7 of The Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing the acquisition of land (0.0314 Hectares) for a public purpose. It contains detailed land descriptions, lot numbers, boundaries, claimant information, and procedures for compensation claims. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
